notes.title: A New Game from C Horse Games
notes.notes:
[h1]Get Blueprint Bob [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3215120/Blueprint_Bob/"]HERE[/url][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41558784/1212a1a2129c1f9431e3c8713ffcf04ec40a1415.png"][/img]
Blueprint Bob is a physics based building puzzle game where you compete against other players on the leaderboards. There are 42 levels, over 30 different blocks, a level editor and ways to send your solutions to other playes.[/p]

notes.title: Blueprint Bob is coming to Steam in 2025
notes.notes: After participating in the GMTK Game Jam for the fifth year in a row, we finally managed to win it! We are going to continue working on our submission "Blueprint Bob" for a full Steam release targeted for 2025 Q2. Stay tuned for more information
